# HTML Audio

#### Course: Learn HTML

## HTML Audio

We use the <audio> tag to embed an audio media player on our webpage. For example,

```html
1<audio controls>
2  <source src="evil_laugh.mp3" type="audio/mp3">
3</audio>
```

Browser Output

![A webpage showing an audio media player.](data:image/png;base64,)

Here,

- src="evil_laugh.mp3" specifies that the audio to be included is a mp3 file named evil_laugh.mp3.
- type="audio/mp3" specifies the type of the audio file.
